Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。
